note: Slovak-citizen stock by destination for 2020, the other side of the definitional contrast.
sql:
SELECT destination_iso3 AS code, value
            FROM 's3.parquet'
            WHERE metric = 'stock'
              AND source = 'eurostat_migr_pop1ctz'
              AND slovak_def = 'citizen'
              AND sex = 'all'
              AND age_bracket = 'all'
              AND education = 'all'
              AND year = 2020
